item.text: I’ll check Mistral’s current official documentation for any published sitemap, index, or machine-readable feed intended for programmatic/model use.

Yes. Mistral publishes an `llms.txt` file specifically suited for handing documentation links and summaries to a model:

[https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt](https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt)

It is plain text and contains a machine-readable list of documentation pages, including titles, URLs, and short descriptions. The listed Markdown URLs can then be fetched for full page content.

Mistral also documents its crawler policies here: [Mistral crawlers](https://docs.mistral.ai/robots). This explains indexing by `MistralAI-Index`, but that is a crawler—not an index you download.
